_comment: NPC factions (Phase 5). startTowns is the default for new worlds made in the game or on a server; the core default (WorldSettings.NpcTowns) is 0.

personalities.name: Merchants
personalities.description: Prefer trade to war: quick to sign trade pacts, slow to anger.

personalities.name: Cautious
personalities.description: Keep to themselves, value non-aggression and alliances, rarely start wars.

personalities.name: Warlike
personalities.description: Respect only strength: demand tribute from the weak and go to war readily.
